en: A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a hilly, patchwork agricultural landscape with fields, trees, and a few scattered farm buildings. In the foreground, a single rail tram or trolley car travels along a line at the base of the hill. At the upper left, printed text reads "Berg en Dal" and below it "Panorama Keteldal." The overall style and printing suggest an early‑20th‑century postcard.
